title: Note taxonomy: DECISION, DEVIATION, TRADEOFF, OPEN-QUESTION prefixes
subject: note-taxonomy
ratio: Task notes SHOULD carry one of four prefixes - DECISION:, DEVIATION:, TRADEOFF:, OPEN-QUESTION: - so evolution audits can grep them mechanically instead of re-reading prose. DECISION: marks a choice made where more than one valid option existed; DEVIATION: marks work that diverged from the plan or spec, disclosed rather than hidden; TRADEOFF: marks a benefit traded for a cost; OPEN-QUESTION: marks an unresolved ambiguity for the join or the next audit to chase. Evolution audits count and chase every OPEN-QUESTION: note to closure before a generation is declared clean. Reach, stated exactly: this is an all-agents rule - it binds any agent writing task notes on the blackboard, in any role and any session - and the duty lives in the standing Note taxonomy (U2) rule inside ORCHESTRATION.md's lifecycle section (section 2, The lifecycle, identical for every engine). That standing, all-agents home is what distinguishes this rule from the planner-only norms born of the same audit generation, and ORCHESTRATION.md is the same contract document the verifier-rotation rule (F6, already codified as PR-004) reached, in its own section 4. The prefix duty is promulgated as SHOULD; the audit's count-and-chase duty on OPEN-QUESTION: notes is stated indicatively in the source and practised as mandatory at generation joins, and this record does not upgrade the first or downgrade the second.
